nodes.description: owner address in Ownable; set in constructor and by transferOwnership, checked by onlyOwner modifier.
paused flag in Pausable, toggled by pause()/unpause(), gates whenNotPaused/whenPaused modifiers.
totalSupply in ERC20Basic; set in constructor, reduced by _burn, increased by mint.
balances mapping in StandardToken; mutated by transfer, transferFrom, _burn, mint.
allowed allowance mapping in StandardToken; mutated by approve, increaseApproval, decreaseApproval, transferFrom.
tokenBlacklist mapping; mutated by _blackList and read in transfer/transferFrom.
token name string, set once in CodeageToken constructor.
token symbol string, set once in CodeageToken constructor.
token decimals, set in constructor and used in supply scaling.
onlyOwner modifier: require(msg.sender == owner); access-control gate for privileged functions.
Ownable.transferOwnership(address newOwner) public onlyOwner; rewrites owner.
Pausable.pause() onlyOwner whenNotPaused; sets paused = true.
Pausable.unpause() onlyOwner whenPaused; sets paused = false.
StandardToken.transfer(address _to, uint256 _value) whenNotPaused; blacklist + balance checks, mutates balances.
StandardToken.transferFrom(_from,_to,_value) whenNotPaused; mutates balances and allowed.
StandardToken.approve(address _spender, uint256 _value); writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
StandardToken.increaseApproval(_spender,_addedValue); adds to allowance via SafeMath.
StandardToken.decreaseApproval(_spender,_subtractedValue); subtracts from allowance with branch to zero.
StandardToken.balanceOf(address _owner) view; returns balances[_owner].
StandardToken.allowance(address,address) view; returns allowed[_owner][_spender].
StandardToken._blackList(address,bool) internal; toggles tokenBlacklist entry and emits Blacklist.
PausableToken.blackListAddress(listAddress,isBlackListed) whenNotPaused onlyOwner; delegates to super._blackList.
CodeageToken.burn(uint256 _value) public; burns msg.sender balance via _burn.
CodeageToken._burn(address _who, uint256 _value) internal; reduces balances and totalSupply.
CodeageToken.mint(address account, uint256 amount) onlyOwner; increases totalSupply and balances.
CodeageToken constructor; sets metadata, totalSupply (unchecked multiply), owner balance and owner.
msg.sender used as caller identity in blacklist checks, allowance keys, burn and onlyOwner.
totalSupply = _supply * 10**_decimals executed without SafeMath (unchecked multiplication / exponentiation).
balances[msg.sender].sub(_value) and balances[_to].add(_value) state mutations in transfer.
balances[_from]/balances[_to]/allowed[_from][msg.sender] mutations in transferFrom.
balances[_who].sub(_value) and totalSupply.sub(_value) mutations in _burn.
totalSupply.add(amount) and balances[account].add(amount) privileged state mutations in mint.
tokenBlacklist[_address] = _isBlackListed state mutation in _blackList (denial-of-transfer capability).
allowed[msg.sender][_spender] write in decreaseApproval, branching on _subtractedValue > oldValue.
allowed[msg.sender][_spender] writes in approve and increaseApproval.

edges.reason: transfer() executes the balance update statements represented by node 28.
transferFrom() executes the balance/allowance update statements represented by node 29.
approve() writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender] (node 34).
increaseApproval() writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender] (node 34).
decreaseApproval() writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender] (node 33).
burn() delegates to internal _burn().
_burn() executes the balance and totalSupply reductions (node 30).
mint() executes the totalSupply/balance increases (node 31).
_blackList() writes tokenBlacklist[_address] (node 32).
blackListAddress() calls super._blackList() to perform the blacklist update.
The constructor computes totalSupply via the unchecked multiplication in node 27.
onlyOwner gates transferOwnership(); modifier body conditionally continues execution.
onlyOwner gates pause() via require(msg.sender == owner).
onlyOwner gates unpause() via require(msg.sender == owner).
onlyOwner gates blackListAddress(), permitting arbitrary address blacklisting by owner.
onlyOwner gates mint(), the only supply-inflation path; owner controls totalSupply.
transfer() keys balances[msg.sender] and enforces tokenBlacklist[msg.sender] == false using caller-controlled address.
transferFrom() uses msg.sender for the blacklist check and as key in allowed[_from][msg.sender].
approve() writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender]; caller fully controls the owner slot.
increaseApproval() indexes allowed[msg.sender][_spender] with the caller address.
decreaseApproval() indexes allowed[msg.sender][_spender] with the caller address.
burn() passes msg.sender as _who, letting any caller destroy their own (unblacklisted) balance.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against owner to authorize privileged calls.
onlyOwner reads the owner state variable for the equality check.
transferOwnership reads current owner for the OwnershipTransferred event.
transferOwnership writes the new owner into the owner state variable.
pause() sets paused = true.
unpause() sets paused = false.
Constructor assigns name = _name.
Constructor assigns symbol = _symbol.
Constructor assigns decimals = _decimals.
Unchecked multiplication result is stored into totalSupply, risking overflow for large _supply/_decimals.
transfer updates balances for sender and recipient.
transferFrom updates balances[_from] and balances[_to].
transferFrom deducts the spent amount from allowed[_from][msg.sender].
_burn reduces totalSupply by the burned value.
_burn reduces balances[_who] by the burned value.
mint increases totalSupply by amount.
mint increases balances[account] by amount.
_blackList writes tokenBlacklist[_address] = _isBlackListed.
decreaseApproval writes the reduced allowance into allowed.
approve/increaseApproval write the new allowance into allowed.
transfer recipient parameter flows into balances[_to] add operation.
transfer value parameter flows into the sub/add balance arithmetic.
transferFrom _from parameter is used as the debited balances and allowed index.
transferFrom _to parameter is credited in balances[_to].
transferFrom _value parameter bounds the transferred amount and allowance deduction.
approve _spender parameter keys the allowance write.
approve _value parameter is stored verbatim as the allowance.
increaseApproval _spender parameter keys the allowance write.
increaseApproval _addedValue parameter is added to the existing allowance.
decreaseApproval _spender parameter keys the allowance write.
decreaseApproval _subtractedValue parameter drives the branch and subtraction.
Local oldValue is compared with _subtractedValue and subtracted from the allowance.
_blackList _address parameter keys the tokenBlacklist write.
_blackList _isBlackListed parameter is the value written into tokenBlacklist.
_burn _who parameter identifies the balance being reduced.
_burn _value parameter is subtracted from both the balance and totalSupply.
mint account parameter is credited with the new tokens.
mint amount parameter increases totalSupply and the account balance.
transferOwnership newOwner parameter becomes the new owner value.
Constructor _supply parameter feeds the unchecked multiplication 10**_decimals.

normalization_plan.reason: The _to parameter only exists to identify the recipient inside transfer(); it should be folded into the function node.
The _value parameter is a transfer-specific amount that has no independent semantic role outside transfer().
The _from parameter is meaningful only as the debited account of transferFrom().
The _to parameter is meaningful only as the credited account of transferFrom().
The _value parameter bounds the delegated transfer and should be merged into transferFrom().
The _spender parameter queries/modifies the allowance slot created by approve().
The _value parameter is the allowance amount written by approve().
The _spender parameter is only used to locate the allowance entry mutated by increaseApproval().
The _addedValue parameter is the delta consumed by increaseApproval()'s SafeMath add.
The _spender parameter is only used to locate the allowance entry mutated by decreaseApproval().
The _subtractedValue parameter is the delta driving the branch and subtraction in decreaseApproval().
The cached allowance oldValue has no meaning outside decreaseApproval(); merge into the function.
The _address parameter is only the key of the tokenBlacklist write performed by _blackList().
The _isBlackListed parameter is the boolean stored by _blackList().
The _who parameter exists only to select the balance reduced by _burn().
The _value parameter is the amount removed from balances and totalSupply in _burn().
The account parameter is only the destination of the privileged mint() credit.
The amount parameter is the inflation quantity added by mint().
The newOwner parameter only exists to overwrite the owner state inside transferOwnership().
The _supply parameter is only consumed by the unchecked multiplication that initializes totalSupply.
